clips.title: The story
paras: Assassination Plot is a Horde quest initiated by recovering intercepted centaur orders in Thousand Needles. The orders reveal an impending strike targeting the tauren Kanati Greycloud at his hunting camp by Whitereach Post.

Thousand Needles has long been contested terrain dominated by warring centaur clans and dangerous wildlife. When the tauren brave Kanati Greycloud set up a hunting camp at Whitereach Post, the small post southwest of the Great Lift, the local centaur viewed it as an audacious intrusion into their territory. Rather than merely driving game away, the centaur resolved to eliminate Greycloud entirely to discourage any further Horde expansion through the canyon.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Tauren, Kanati Greycloud is bold to set up a hunting camp in Thousand Needles. We must kill him to rid this hunting camp and all who may follow him. We will converge at the small post Southwest of the Great Lift.

clips.title: Completion
paras: They come to kill me? I will show them how a Tauren fights!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
